mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a single month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP growth rate over two consecutive quarters indicates a strengthening economy, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the GDP growth rate is positive, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% over three months signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage costs and reduces profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production index by more than 1% over two months signals increased economic activity, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.1 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in housing starts and real GDP indicates a robust economic expansion, which boosts consumer and business confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where both proxies show positive growth, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate coupled with an increase in nonfarm payrolls signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where both proxies show favorable conditions, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate coupled with an increase in real GDP signals a supportive monetary policy in a growing economy, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where both proxies show favorable conditions, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail and food services sales signals increased consumer spending, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the retail and food services sales increase, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.
